title: Elko or Sheridan
what_we_know: The post dates the wedding to August 28, 1958 and says it is "strongly believed" to have been in Elko, Nevada. Jack Alexander's obituary (plate 37) says he married Angelina Calicura in 1958 at Sheridan, Wyoming.
what_we_dont: Where they married. The museum holds no marriage record.
what_might_answer_it: Marriage records for 1958 in Elko County, Nevada and Sheridan County, Wyoming.
